newsitem.title: FINLAND: ASKO TO SELL SUPERLON UNIT FOR FIM 30 MLN.
newsitem.headline: ASKO TO SELL SUPERLON UNIT FOR FIM 30 MLN.

text.p: Finnish plastic pipe and furniture maker Asko Oy said on Friday it would sell its foam rubber unit Suomen Superlon Oy for about 30 million markka to a new company, partly owned by Asko.
"The buyer is a company to be established, Suomen Brekke Oy, of which Norwegian Brekke Industrier AS's holding is 83.3 percent and Asko Huonekalu Oy's 16.7 percent," Asko said in a statement.
Suomen Superlon's 1995 net sales were 49.2 million markka, and it had 83 employees, Asko said.

"The sale of Suomen Superlon ... is part of Asko Huonekalu Oy's strategy to release capital from the early part of the production chain for core furniture operations and for development of the retail sales concept," Asko said.
